# summarize_ints

summarize_ints(nums) sorts the distinct integers in nums and joins them with commas, writing every run of 4 OR MORE consecutive integers as first-last. Inside a range, a negative endpoint is written in parentheses; outside a range, numbers are written plainly. summarize_ints([]) == "".

Examples:

- `summarize_ints([4, -4, 0, 10, 9, 13, 2, 3]) == '-4,0,2,3,4,9,10,13'`
- `summarize_ints([2, 1, 10, 11]) == '1,2,10,11'`
